1  HON'BLE JAI PRAKASH TIWARI, J.
Heard Sri Ram Sanehi Yadav, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Shiv Shankar Kaithal, learned counsel for opposite party and Sri Rajeev Kumar Singh, learned AGA for the State.

The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the charge sheet dated 28.08.2017 as well as the entire proceedings of Case No. 49/2018 (State Vs. Prabhat Kishor and others), arising out of Case Crime No. 046/2017, under Sections- 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C., and Section- 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station- Mahila Thana, District- Firozabad.

entities.text: Case No. 49/2018 (State Vs. Prabhat Kishor and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It has been contended by learned counsel for the applicants that the applicant no. 1 and opposite party no. 2 are husband and wife and they have amicably settled their dispute and entered into a compromise and the learned Magistrate verified the compromise entered into between the parties vide order dated 12.03.2025, hence the proceeding against the applicants be quashed.

Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 has admitted the fact of the compromise and submitted that the applicants and opp. party No.2 have compromised the dispute and as such opp. party No.2 does not want to press the present case against the applicants.
Compromise verification report in compliance of order dated 25.1.2024, passed by this Court has been received from the court concerned.
Hence, considering the facts and circumstances of the case and nature of offence the proceeding of the aforesaid case hereby quashed.
The present 482 Cr.P.C. application stands allowed.

(Jai Prakash Tiwari,J.) March 31, 2026 S.K.
